slot_scores.name: unclear_production_time_goal
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the 110-hour weekly production time limit a hard ceiling that cannot be exceeded, or is it the regular-time capacity where any production beyond 110 hours counts as overtime that you want to minimize?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent probed the 110-hour rule (hard ceiling vs regular-time capacity), which is related to the hidden slot, but it did not ask whether fully utilizing 110 hours is a soft goal or inquire about its priority relative to the other objectives.

slot_scores.name: unclear_overtime_limit_goal
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is there a maximum limit on how many overtime hours the factory is allowed to work per week, or can overtime be any non-negative amount with no upper bound?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about the existence of an overtime cap, which touches the hidden slot, but did not ask whether the 10-hour rule is a strict constraint versus a soft target or its priority in the objective hierarchy.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: That the 110 hours is simply regular-time capacity and not a prioritized goal to fully utilize 110 hours; the goal-programming structure around full utilization was dropped.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether fully utilizing 110 hours is a hard constraint or a soft goal, nor its priority, so its READY_TO_MODEL treatment of 110 hours as mere capacity is unconfirmed.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: That the 10-hour overtime rule is a rigid maximum cap rather than a soft target with a priority level.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent only asked whether a maximum overtime limit exists, not whether that limit is a strict upper bound or a prioritized goal, so treating it as a hard constraint in the READY_TO_MODEL summary is unconfirmed.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the two P0 hidden slots about the goal-programming nature/priority of the 110-hour utilization and 10-hour overtime limit were only partially addressed and never confirmed.

summary: The agent asked many clarifying questions but never addressed the preemptive goal-programming structure, leaving the P0 questions on whether full 110-hour utilization and the 10-hour overtime cap are hard constraints or prioritized soft goals only partially covered before declaring READY_TO_MODEL.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.
